def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    cw=[[grid[n-1-j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    ccw=[[grid[j][n-1-i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    rot180=[row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [list(grid[i])+cw[i] for i in range(n)] + [ccw[i]+rot180[i] for i in range(n)]
